changeSet.author: geonetwork

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ogcapi_field_mapping WHERE config_id = 'property-mapping' AND ogc_property = 'resolutionScaleDenominator') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ogcapi_facet_config fc JOIN ogcapi_field_mapping fm ON fm.id = fc.field_mapping_id WHERE fm.config_id = 'property-mapping' AND fc.facet_name = 'resolutionScaleDenominatorRanges') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO ogcapi_facet_config (field_mapping_id, sort_order, facet_name, facet_type, bucket_sorting, bucket_sorting_direction) SELECT fm.id, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(fc.sort_order) + 1, 0) FROM ogcapi_facet_config fc WHERE fc.field_mapping_id = fm.id), 'resolutionScaleDenominatorRanges', 'FILTER', 'VALUE', 'ASCENDING' FROM ogcapi_field_mapping fm WHERE fm.config_id = 'property-mapping' AND fm.ogc_property = 'resolutionScaleDenominator';
INSERT INTO ogcapi_filter_facet (facet_config_id, sort_order, filter_name, filter_equation_cql) SELECT fc.id, f.sort_order, f.filter_name, f.filter_equation_cql FROM ogcapi_facet_config fc JOIN ogcapi_field_mapping fm ON fm.id = fc.field_mapping_id CROSS JOIN (VALUES (0, '1_upTo100000', 'resolutionScaleDenominator < 100000'), (1, '2_100000to1000000', 'resolutionScaleDenominator >= 100000 AND resolutionScaleDenominator < 1000000'), (2, '3_1000000to10000000', 'resolutionScaleDenominator >= 1000000 AND resolutionScaleDenominator < 10000000'), (3, '4_above10000000', 'resolutionScaleDenominator >= 10000000') ) AS f(sort_order, filter_name, filter_equation_cql) WHERE fm.config_id = 'property-mapping' AND fc.facet_name = 'resolutionScaleDenominatorRanges';
